how_to_read: 'turns' is the tester's evidence exactly as sent: prompt, the reply the agent gave, the action trace. Nothing in it is an expectation. 'conversations' is the spec, written and reviewed by a person: each conversation is played in order against one customer, and every step says what the backend must do. A step names an evidence turn ('turn') or, when it is ours rather than the tester's, gives the message ('say') and why it was added ('added_because'). 'expect' uses only the keys the runner knows - any other key fails the run - and 'check' names a Python check in test_readiness_replay.py for what the keys cannot say. Every turn is also held to the invariants in the runner, whatever its expect says.
